card.title: No Tie Stands
card.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We split the bill exactly. Rate dinner out of ten. Lower score pays the tip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because then nobody wins. I give dinner nine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dessert names, then. Take turns. First person who repeats one pays. I will start: cheesecake.
